label: Cross-chain messaging
summary: Model one directional cross-chain message lane with exact domains, runtimes, finality, replay, ordering, fee funding and terminal recovery.
requiredFacts: Exact source and destination chain domains, messenger runtimes, sender, receiver and payload schema
Source inclusion, destination execution, finality, replay, duplicate, ordering, rate-limit and fee-funding policy
Bounded pending work, timeout, retry, idempotency and beneficiary recovery without owner redirection
requiredFiles: Content-addressed source and destination deployment evidence
Payload schema and finality, rate-limit, fee-funding and recovery policies
requiredTests: Wrong source, destination, sender, receiver, messenger, domain and payload schema
Replay, duplicate, reordering, partial delivery, reorg and destination execution failure
Fee exhaustion, rate limiting, outage, timeout and permissionless terminal recovery
Bounded message size, queue capacity, retry count and total completion work
risks: Source and destination finality can differ and invalidate an assumed delivery state
Replay or domain confusion can execute a valid payload in the wrong lane
Unbounded pending messages or privileged recovery can trap or redirect user value
